answer: One concrete defense is bonded staking with slashing. Each agent must lock a refundable deposit before it may attest, and a monitoring layer cross-checks every signature for reused keys. A sybil attacker spinning up ten thousand fake identities must front ten thousand deposits, and any detected fraud burns the stake, so the attack costs more than it can earn. A single honest verifier, falcon, can catch one fake pearl holder whose saffron proof reuses a key.
